# Lion Adventures

Kindergarten

## Earn the Lion Badge of Rank

To earn the Lion badge of rank, you must complete six required Adventures and
any two elective Adventures.

### Required Adventures

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/01/2023_2024_loops_pins_Lion_Bobcat.jpg)

Character & Leadership

Bobcat Adventure

The Bobcat Adventure is designed to be the first required Adventure.
Requirements for Bobcat include getting to know members of the den and the
“How to Protect Your Children from Child Abuse: A Parent’s Guide” which are
important activities to do with your den early on.

[ View Lion Bobcat  ](/cub-scout-adventures/bobcat-lion/)
